format: html

SImulate 100 tosses

```{r}
set.seed(3)
values=c("H","T")
tosses=sample(values,100,replace=TRUE)
```

Count number of heads

```{r}
sum(tosses=="H")
```

Replicating coin tosses

```{r}
tosses=replicate(10000,
          sum(sample(values,100,replace=TRUE)=="H")
          )
```

```{r}
hist(tosses)
```

```{r}
sum(tosses>=60)/10000
```
